{{Quote|Bettle and Jaxa have been busy marketing slug throwers to various warring primitive species in an undisclosed region just beyond the Corporate Sector. ''[&hellip;]'' They've rebounded nicely, though, returning to semi-civilized space with cargo holds bulging with canta salt and havao tabacc.|A news report by Cynabar's InfoNet|<ref name="GNN" />}}
'''Canta salt''' was a type of [[Salt/Legends|salt]].<ref name="GNN" /> On the [[Great ReSynchronization calendar|date]] [[0 ABY/Legends|36:1:16]], a news report by [[Cynabar's InfoNet/Legends|Cynabar's InfoNet]] noted that<ref name="GNN" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Heroes&Rogues">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref> [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Bettle]] and<ref name="GNN" /> her<ref name="Heroes&Rogues" /> partner [[Jaxa]], who had been selling [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]] to several warring low-technology [[Species/Legends|species]] in territories beyond<ref name="GNN" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], had returned with large amounts of valuable canta salt and [[havao tabacc]] in the cargo holds of their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Mallixer]]''. The report also noted that the vessel needed repairs and that the smuggling duo's last known heading was [[Bretta]],<ref name="GNN" /> in the Outer Rim's [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Bretta system/Legends|Bretta system]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Canta salt was introduced by [[Paul Sudlow]] in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine, which was published in [[February]] [[1995]].<ref name="GNN" />
